definitions.explanation: The act of stopping or restraining someone from doing something, typically by physical intervention or verbal command. Often used when preventing someone from acting rashly or dangerously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{制止|せいし}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The people around held him back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制止|せいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{切|き}って→振り切る：06703_furikiru⟧⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧。
examples.english: He broke free from the security guard's restraint and ran out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制止|せいし}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聞|き}か→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ず、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: Ignoring his friend's attempts to stop him, he headed for the dangerous area.

notes:
Often appears in news and literary contexts describing scenes where someone is being physically or verbally restrained.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {制止|せいし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to restrain, to stop someone)
- {制止|せいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{切|き}る→振り切る：06703_furikiru⟧ (to shake off restraint)
- {制止|せいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}する→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧ (to ignore attempts to stop one)
- {制止|せいし}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聞|き}か→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ず (ignoring attempts to stop one)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {制止|せいし} — stopping someone from acting (physical/verbal intervention)
- ⟦{抑制|よくせい}→抑制：05635_yokusei⟧ — suppression, restraint (broader; includes self-restraint and systemic controls)
